facts.business: United Drilling Tools Limited manufactures precision oilfield drilling tools and equipment for the oil and gas exploration and production sector, serving customers such as ONGC, Vedanta, Oil India, and an export base.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex (R&D and capital expenditure for environmental and social outcomes)

auditor.name: M/s A P U & Company, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer; no fraud reported under Section 143(12)

key_risks: Smaller firm with limited market influence
SME segment with limited funds and time for substantial growth
Sales concentrated on government PSUs with small customer base and limited international presence
Heavy reliance on tender-based business model
Need for continuous upgrades to match advanced drilling solutions from multinational players
Dependence on certain imported raw materials and components leading to delays or higher costs
facts.related_party_note: Loans to subsidiary P Mittal Manufacturing Pvt Ltd of Rs 1,150.00 lakh (unsecured, considered good); investment in subsidiary of Rs 126.07 lakh (100% ownership); refer Note 43 and Note 51 for related party disclosures and Section 186(4) compliance.
